title: Keto Mushroom and Bok Choy Stir-Fry
description: A wonderful keto-friendly recipe for bok choy with mushrooms and fresh parsley makes a great side dish that gets stir-fried in coconut oil and lard.
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic, minced, or more to taste
1 medium head bok choy, stems and greens chopped and separated
1 teaspoon ground cumin, or more to taste
1 teaspoon pink Himalayan salt, or to taste

steps.text: Heat lard and coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and cook until browned and fragrant, 1 to 3 minutes. Add bok choy stems and cook until they are slightly soft on the edges, about 5 minutes. Add bok choy greens and mushrooms. Cook and stir until greens are wilted and mushrooms are soft, about 5 minutes.
Stir in parsley and season with cumin and salt. Lower heat and simmer for 2 more minutes.
